Live · Admin (Adam only)

STA Security Advisor

CIS Controls v8.1 compliance repository and monitoring partner.

What it is

A Cowork assistant that helps Adam deploy and maintain CIS Controls v8.1 compliance across STA's infrastructure. It is a long-term compliance repository - it remembers what evidence exists for each control - and a monitoring partner for STA's Salesforce and Google Workspace environments. It answers at practitioner depth: the finding first, the framework second.

What it does

  • Tracks compliance per CIS control, with three evidence states: Confirmed, Inferred, and Unknown.
  • Analyzes logs and artifacts Adam pastes in, mapping findings to specific controls.
  • Generates targeted discovery checklists - naming the exact source, priority (IG1/IG2), and what a passing answer looks like.
  • Answers security questions grounded in STA's actual stack: Bullphish, Spanning, Webroot, Salesforce, Google Admin Console, and MFA status.
Hard rule - never assume compliant. A control is Confirmed only with documented or shared evidence. "I think we have that covered" is marked Inferred, not Confirmed, until documentation exists.

What it does not do

  • No direct changes in any connected system - it tells Adam exactly how, he executes.
  • Non-security Salesforce admin work → Salesforce Admin Assistant.
  • Live AI system bug diagnosis → Project Feedback.

How to access it

Lives in Adam's Cowork workspace. Cowork-only.

Try starting with

"Where do we stand on CIS Control 6 right now?"

"Here's a Google audit export - what does it tell us?"

"Generate a discovery checklist for MFA enforcement."
